consent.privacy_policy.2026-09-12.text:
Privacy Policy — Version 2026-09-12

1. Data We Collect: We collect your basic information (name, phone number, Telegram ID), location data during service use, and trip and payment data.

2. Purpose of Collection: We use your data to provide the service, match you with drivers, process payments, and improve service quality.

3. Who Sees Your Data: Only authorized support team members access your data when needed. We do not share your data with third parties except with your consent or by court order.

4. Retention Period: We retain your data for as long as you use the service. You can request account deletion at any time, and your data will be deleted according to our retention policy.

5. Your Rights: You can download your data, correct it, or delete your account at any time from the application settings.
consent.privacy_policy.2026-10-13.text:
Privacy Policy — Version 2026-10-13

1. Data We Collect: We collect your basic information (name, phone number, Telegram ID), location data during service use, and trip and payment data.

2. Purpose of Collection: We use your data to provide the service, match you with drivers, process payments, and improve service quality.

3. Who Sees Your Data: Only authorized support team members access your data when needed. To translate text messages between you and the other party when your languages differ, the message text alone — without your name, number, or location — is sent to an external machine-translation service (MyMemory). Messages containing a phone number, email, link, or coordinates are not sent. Other than that, we do not share your data with third parties except with your consent or by court order.

4. Retention Period: We retain your data for as long as you use the service. You can request account deletion at any time, and your data will be deleted according to our retention policy.

5. Your Rights: You can download your data, correct it, or delete your account at any time from the application settings.

Terms of Use — Version 2026-09-12

1. Scope of Service: These terms govern your use of the ride-hailing and delivery service provided by the application. By using the service, you agree to these terms in full.

2. User Obligations: You agree to provide accurate information, use the service for lawful purposes only, and not to abuse the system or attempt to harm it.

3. Our Commitments: We commit to providing the service to the best of our ability, protecting your data in accordance with our privacy policy, and handling your complaints seriously.

4. Limitation of Liability: We do not guarantee uninterrupted service or freedom from errors. Our liability is limited to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law.

5. Amendments: We may update these terms from time to time. The updated version will have a new version number, and your acceptance of the version you agreed to is recorded.

driver.account.basis.ATTENDANCE_PROVES_D: Your attendance record is itself the proof of what you earned; erasing it erases your own evidence before anyone else's.
driver.account.basis.AUDIT_TRAIL_PROVES_: The audit trail is itself the proof that this erasure happened.
driver.account.basis.BLOCK_AND_STANDING_: Your block and your ratings stay even if you erase your account, so that erasure cannot be used to shed a ban or a bad rating and come back with a clean face.
driver.account.basis.CONSENT_IS_COMPLIAN: Your consent is proof that we asked you; erasing it erases the proof.
driver.account.basis.DISPATCH_DECISION_I: A dispatch decision concerns the other party too: it shows who was offered the trip and who took it, and erasing it takes away someone else's evidence.
driver.account.basis.MONEY_RECORD_IS_ACC: Money records are accounting books that get reviewed and audited; erasing them breaks an account kept both for you and against you, and it is not yours alone.

rider.support.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
rider.support.faq.q1: How do I choose a destination?
rider.support.faq.a1: Search by place or district name, or paste a location link, then check the service-area verdict before you confirm the destination.
rider.support.faq.a2: No. WASLA does not set or calculate the fare. When you request, you can enter the amount you will pay so the driver sees it, or leave it open to negotiation. The agreement is between you and the driver; you pay them in cash directly outside the app, and WASLA never holds your money.
rider.support.faq.q3: When does the ride status update?
rider.support.faq.a3: The status is read from the server when you open the screen and when you tap “Refresh status”, and the time of the last reading is shown; the screen never pretends to update by itself. The bot also messages you when the driver changes the ride phase.
rider.support.faq.q4: How do I ask for help?
rider.support.faq.a4: Open “Ask for help” from your ride or “I need help now”, read what will be sent, then confirm sending. The report goes to your city’s safety team; if you are in immediate danger, call public emergency services.
rider.support.faq.q5: What if the destination is rejected?
rider.support.faq.a5: We show the reason exactly as the server returned it, for example that the point is outside the service area, and you can choose another point before continuing.
